scenarios.prompt: Author a directed cancel/link/juggle route graph whose edges reference action-feel timing, resources and hit/recovery owners.

criteria.ownership: State/resource semantics stay with the named skill while timing/input/presentation owners remain external where applicable.
criteria.identity: Stable IDs/transactions/options make duplicate callbacks and boundary cases deterministic.
criteria.evidence: Normal, boundary and adversarial traces reconcile to published state without hidden universal assumptions.
